on setupSpeechToText
	 local tBrowserName,tStack,tScript
	 	
	 if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then
		 put "Appli_Player" into tStack
	 else
		 put "Appli" into tStack
	 end if 
	 
	 put "browser cs control " into tBrowserName
	 put gAppliA["browserID"]["Data"] after tBrowserName
	 set the javascripthandlers of widget "browser" of group tBrowserName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "AudioTransferStart" & lf & "AudioChunk" & lf & "AudioTransferComplete"
	 
	 // THIS LINE NUMBER MIGHT NEED UPDATING SOMETIMES IF THIS SCRIPT CHANGES.
	 put line 37 to 500 of the script of me into tScript
	 put "global gAppliA" & lf before tScript
	 set the script of widget "browser" of group tBrowserName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tScript
	 
end setupSpeechToText

//***************************************************************
// THE SCRIPT OF THE WIDGET IS SET TO THE SCRIPT BELOW
//***************************************************************

//VARIABLE TO HOLD THE INCOMING DATA STREAM
local sAudioBuffer

// 2. RESET BUFFER WHEN UPLOAD STARTS
on AudioTransferStart pData
	 // pData contains metadata like size/gAppliA["filename"]["Data"] if you need it
	 put empty into sAudioBuffer 
end AudioTransferStart

// 3. APPEND EACH CHUNK AS IT ARRIVES
on AudioChunk pData
	 put pData
	 local tArray
	 
	 // Convert the JSON chunk info
	 put JSONToArray(pData) into tArray
	 
	 // Decode this specific chunk and append it to our buffer
	 // Note: The JS now strips the "data:Audio..." header, so we just decode directly
	 put base64Decode(tArray["data"]) after sAudioBuffer
end AudioChunk

// 4. SAVE TO DISK WHEN FINISHED
on AudioTransferComplete pData
	 put sAudioBuffer into gAppliA["lastKnownSpeechRecording"]
	try	 
		LemonfoxTranscribeAudioData sAudioBuffer,"webm","IF9fxDl0RYrWttW7chjeu3JpXE6B8tIG"
		catch tError
		answer "Error: " & tError
	end try
end AudioTransferComplete

command LemonfoxTranscribeAudioData pAudioData, pFileExt, pApiKey
	 // DECLARE VARIABLES
	 local tURL, tHeaders, tTempPath, tFilePart
	 local tForm, tError, tResponse, tTheText
	local tButtonName, tStack
	 
	 // ENDPOINT
	 put "https://api.lemonfox.ai/v1/audio/transcriptions" into tURL
	 
	 // WRITE AUDIO BYTES TO A TEMP FILE
	 // NOTE: pAudioData MUST BE BINARY AUDIO BYTES
	 put specialFolderPath("temporary") & "/recording_" & the milliseconds & "." & (pFileExt) into tTempPath
	 put pAudioData into url("binfile:" & tTempPath)
	 
	 // BUILD MULTIPART FILE VALUE
	 put "<file>" & tTempPath into tFilePart
	 
	 // BUILD MULTIPART FORM (RETURNS ERROR STRING)
	 put empty into tForm
	 //put libURLMultipartFormData(tForm, \
	 //"file", tFilePart, \
	 //"language", "english", \
	 //"response_format", "json") into tError
	
	switch questionType
		case "fill in"
			put libURLMultipartFormData(tForm, \
			 "file", tFilePart, \
			 "prompt", "The transcript is a student answer for a fill in the blank question. Words do not need to be capitalized unless it's the first word of a sentence or a proper noun. Only use punctuation when needed. Differentiate between words and numbers. The question is:" && questionText && "Acceptable answer example:" && currentCorrectAnswer, \
			 "response_format", "json") into tError
			break
		
		case "written"
			put libURLMultipartFormData(tForm, \
			 "file", tFilePart, \
			 "prompt", "The transcript is a student answer for a free response question. Only capitalize words when needed. Only use punctuation when needed. Differentiate between words and numbers. The question is:" && questionText && "Acceptable answer example:" && currentCorrectAnswer, \
			 "response_format", "json") into tError
			break
	end switch
	 
	 if tError is not empty then
		 answer "Form build error:" && tError
		 exit LemonfoxTranscribeAudioData
	 end if
	 
	 // HEADERS: MULTIPART CONTENT-TYPE (LINE 1) + AUTH
	 put "Authorization: Bearer " & pApiKey into tHeaders
	 set the httpHeaders to line 1 of tForm & return & tHeaders
	 
	 // POST BODY (LINES 2..END)
	 post line 2 to -1 of tForm to url tURL
	 put it into tResponse
	 
	 // CLEANUP HEADERS
	 set the httpHeaders to empty
	 
	 // HANDLE ERRORS
	 if the result is not empty then
		 answer "HTTP error:" && the result & return & tResponse
	 else
		 put jsonToArray(tResponse) into tTheText
		 put tTheText["text"] into tTheText
		put tTheText into studentTranscription
		put "button cs control " into tButtonName
		 put gAppliA["closeBrowserButtonID"]["Data"] after tButtonName
		if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then
			 put "Appli_Player" into tStack
		 else
			 put "Appli" into tStack
		 end if 
		dispatch "speechToTextSetAnswer" to group tButtonName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		dispatch "mouseUp" to group tButtonName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	 end if
end LemonfoxTranscribeAudioData
